name: reactor-entrance-equals-scratch
description: #74 Tier 2 acceptance, second link of the chain: start from the snapshot "reactor-entrance" that new-game-to-reactor-entrance kept earlier in this run (scenarios run in file name order), wait 2 s, and compare the end state (main RAM and picture, by hash inside the sandbox, reported only as 1/0) with the same script played (a) again from the snapshot (match_rerun) and (b) with no snapshot at all: a fresh power-on, the title boot point's presses, new-game-to-reactor-entrance's script and then this one, in one core instance (match_boot). snapshot_frames is the frames from power-on to reactor-entrance. If the snapshot was not kept, this scenario does not run and reports error ("no snapshot"). No FF7 address is used or claimed.
